scripts.debugbuild: cd android && gradlew clean && cd .. && npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.releasebuild: cd android && gradlew clean && cd .. && npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.reverse: adb reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000 && adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 || echo "[reverse] skipped - no device attached"
scripts.android:debug: npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug & cd ..
scripts.pod:remove: cd ios && rm -rf Pods && rm -rf Podfile.lock
